title: Gravity AI UI
description: Search public Gravity AI UI drafts and generate Gravity UI interface payloads.
summary: Search public Gravity AI UI drafts and generate Gravity UI interface payloads.
offersHint: Search public Gravity AI UI drafts and generate Gravity UI interface payloads. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://gravity-ai.ydb-qdrant.tech/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_interfaces
toolsPreview.description: Use to discover public liked Gravity AI UI interface drafts by title, summary, or id. This returns public gallery metadata only. Use get_interface when you need the full payload or React code for a known id.

toolsPreview.name: get_interface
toolsPreview.description: Use when you already have a public Gravity AI UI gallery id and need the sanitized public interface metadata, composed payload, thumbnail URLs, page URL, and copyable React code.

toolsPreview.name: generate_interface
toolsPreview.description: Use to generate a new Gravity AI UI composed interface from a prompt. This calls the public generator with the server OpenAI configuration and does not save or publish the result.

toolsPreview.name: refine_interface
toolsPreview.description: Use to refine a previously generated Gravity AI UI composed payload with a natural-language instruction. This does not save or publish the result.
